response.original_title: [FAQs Support Guide] Can You Upgrade Your Room After Booking a Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: To upgrade your suite on a Silversea cruise, you can use the Silversea Upgrade bid program +1-888-512-8367, contact customer support or your travel agent directly +1-888-512-8367, or look out for pre-cruise upgrade offers. Main Ways to Upgrade Silversea Upgrade (Bid-Based Program): If your voyage is eligible, you will receive an invitation +1-888-512-8367 or can check online via the Silversea Upgrade page to browse available higher suite categories and submit a monetary offer per suite for the full length of your voyage +1-888-512-8367. If accepted, you pay the bid amount; if rejected +1-888-512-8367, you keep your original suite at no extra cost. Direct Call or Travel Agent: You can call Silversea directly at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada), or reach out to your travel advisor to check for open suite categories and pay the fare difference to switch rooms +1-888-512-8367.
